The outing

🌷 NC Botanical Garden

100 Old Mason Farm Rd, Chapel Hill, NC 27517 · Chapel Hill / Pittsboro

Arrive 9:30 am, leave by 11:30 am · Free · Outdoors

Chilly while you’re there: about 48–59°F. Coats and hats.

Add to calendar

NC Botanical Garden

Google CalendarOpens Google Calendar with the event filled in, ready to save. Apple, Outlook or another calendarDownloads a calendar file. Open it on an iPhone, Mac or Outlook and tap Add.

Your child can follow the display garden paths and then head onto the forest trails behind them, stopping wherever they like. Free, and open from 9 am.

  • Bring a snack and eat it on a bench before the forest trails.
  • Let your child pick which path to take at each turn.
  • Say 'one more look' ten minutes before you leave so the goodbye is easy.

Or swap in

  • 🔬 Early Childhood Drop-In

    Hideaway Woods, Museum of Life and Science · Durham · 10 am–11:30 am

    Map · Included with museum admission · No sign-up needed

    Sensory play, songs and stories in Hideaway Woods, a drop-in your child can join and leave as they like. It comes with museum admission and needs no sign-up.

    • Come any time in the stretch and stay as long as your child is happy.
    • Bring a change of clothes in case sensory play gets messy.

  • 📅 Park Tales: If You Find a Leaf

    Historic Yates Mill County Park · Raleigh · 9:50 am–10:45 am

    Map · Free · Sign-up needed

    Park staff read a fall story about what a leaf could become, outdoors at Yates Mill. A family needs to sign up first. It is free.

    • Pick up a leaf on the way in and see what your child says it is.
    • Bring a small snack for after the story.

  • 📖 Toddler Storytime, then Apex Community Park

    Eva Perry Regional Library · Cary / Apex · 9:20 am–11 am

    Map · Free · Sign-up not listed

    Toddler Storytime has books, music, rhymes and movement, then your child can run at Apex Community Park. Pick up a ticket at the Youth Services desk.

    • Get the ticket first, then settle in with the other children.
    • Save the snack for the park so the transition is easy.

  • 🌳 Lake Benson Park

    South Wake · 3 pm–4:30 pm

    Map · Free

    An afternoon at Lake Benson Park gives your child a playground and greenway to explore after the nap. It is a good way to burn off energy before dinner.

    • Bring a snack and a water bottle.
    • Head home while there is still plenty of daylight so the evening stays calm.

Nothing else fits that today.

    South Wake · 4:30 pm–6 pm

    Map · Free

    An afternoon at Lake Benson Park gives your child a playground and greenway to explore after the nap. It is a good way to burn off energy before dinner.

  • 🔬 Early Childhood Drop-In

    Hideaway Woods, Museum of Life and Science · Durham · 10 am–11:30 am

    Map · Included with museum admission · No sign-up needed

    Songs, stories and sensory play in Hideaway Woods. Your child can drop in, play their way, and leave when they are ready. It comes with museum admission and needs no sign-up.

    • Arrive early in the stretch so there is time for the songs.
    • Bring a change of clothes for messy play.

  • 📅 Park Tales: If You Find a Leaf

    Historic Yates Mill County Park · Raleigh · 9:50 am–10:45 am

    Map · Free · Sign-up needed

    A fall story about what a leaf could become, read outdoors at Yates Mill. A family needs to sign up first. It is free.

    • Collect a leaf on the way in.
    • Have a snack ready for the ride home.

  • 📖 Family Storytime, then Apex Community Park

    Eva Perry Regional Library · Cary / Apex · 10:20 am–11:45 am

    Map · Free · Sign-up not listed

    Family Storytime with books, music, rhymes and movement, then your child can play at Apex Community Park. Pick up a ticket at the Youth Services desk.

    • Get the ticket before the story starts.
    • Let your child choose the first thing to do at the park.

  • 🌷 NC Botanical Garden

    Chapel Hill / Pittsboro · 11 am–1 pm

    Map · Free

    Your child can follow the display garden paths and then head onto the forest trails behind them, stopping wherever they like. Free, and open from 9 am.

    • Bring a snack and eat it on a bench before the forest trails.
    • Let your child pick which path to take at each turn.
    • Say 'one more look' ten minutes before you leave so the goodbye is easy.

  • 📖 Storytime Stay and Play, then Green Road Park

    Green Road Community Library · North Raleigh / Wake Forest · 10:20 am–12:15 pm

    Map · Free · Sign-up not listed

    A storytime, then creative stations with playdough, building materials and crafts. Your child can then run it off at Green Road Park next door.

    • Let your child pick one station and stay as long as they like.
    • Bring a snack for the park and a water bottle.
    • Name the first thing to do at the park to make leaving the library easy.

  • 📅 Total Tot Time, then Walltown Park

    Walltown Park Rec Ctr · Durham · 9:50 am–12:30 pm

    Map · Cost not listed · Sign-up needed

    Your child plays in the gym with a parachute and tunnels, then goes outside to Walltown Park. A family needs to sign up first.

    • Wear shoes that are easy to slip on and off.
    • Bring a snack and a water bottle for after the gym.

  • 🌳 Hemlock Bluffs Nature Preserve

    Cary / Apex · 11 am–1 pm

    Map · Free

    Your child can walk the trails and boardwalks through the woods at Hemlock Bluffs, taking the stairs and stopping to look at whatever they find.

    • The trails have stairs, so pack a carrier for tired legs.
    • Bring a snack for halfway.
